title: Martha Stewart is the face of Hint, an AI app for home maintenance
content_html:
Martha Stewart just launched an app that uses AI to analyze the soil quality in your lawn. And yes, every part of that sentence is true.

The app is called Hint, from a startup of the same name that counts the popular former TV host as a co-founder. It's available now on iOS and coming soon to the Google Play Store.

Hint uses AI to create personalized insights for home maintenance, perhaps one of the few areas of modern life that hasn't already been overrun by AI apps.

You May Also Like

"My life’s work is showing people how to care for and beautify their homes," Stewart says on Hint's website. "Hint brings that philosophy to more people, making the knowledge and expertise behind thoughtful homeownership accessible to everyone."

Mashable Light Speed

Hint asks users to enter their home addresses, which may be a turnoff for some customers given the potential for privacy issues. If you do feel like sharing, Hint will use your address to start analyzing things like the soil and air quality on your property, available utilities, and anything else it can dredge up using public property records.

You can also upload vital documents like mortgages and warranties to the app, if you trust Hint that much. The idea is to give users a comprehensive, personalized outlook on things like energy usage, insurance risks, and anything else that can come up in the process of owning a home.

Hint's website claims its insights come from experts such as Stewart herself. There's also an in-app AI chatbot you can talk to if you have questions about home ownership.

If you can get over the trust issue, Hint could well provide intriguing practical insights on one of the more complex and tedious areas of daily life. And that, in theory, is a good thing.

content_html_zh:
玛莎·斯图尔特刚刚推出了一款应用程序，使用人工智能来分析草坪的土壤质量。 是的，这句话的每个部分都是正确的。

该应用程序名为 Hint，来自一家同名初创公司，该公司的联合创始人是这位受欢迎的前电视主持人。 它现已在 iOS 上推出，并将很快登陆 Google Play 商店。

Hint 使用人工智能为家庭维护创建个性化见解，这可能是现代生活中少数尚未被人工智能应用程序占领的领域之一。

你可能也喜欢

“我一生的工作就是向人们展示如何护理和美化他们的家园，”斯图尔特在辛特的网站上说道。 “Hint 将这一理念带给更多人，让每个人都能获得深思熟虑的购房背后的知识和专业知识。”

可混搭光速

提示要求用户输入他们的家庭住址，考虑到潜在的隐私问题，这可能会让一些客户望而却步。 如果您确实想分享，Hint 将使用您的地址开始分析您的财产上的土壤和空气质量、可用的公用设施以及它可以使用公共财产记录挖掘的其他任何内容。

如果您非常信任提示，您还可以将抵押和保修等重要文件上传到应用程序。 其想法是让用户对能源使用、保险风险以及拥有房屋过程中可能出现的任何其他问题有一个全面、个性化的看法。

辛特的网站声称其见解来自斯图尔特本人等专家。 如果您对房屋所有权有疑问，还可以与应用内的人工智能聊天机器人交谈。

如果你能克服信任问题，提示很可能会针对日常生活中较复杂和乏味的领域之一提供有趣的实用见解。 从理论上讲，这是一件好事。
